mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_dept d WHERE 1=1

when.test: searchVO != null and searchVO.searchKeyword != null and searchVO.searchKeyword != ''

choose.when:
WITH RECURSIVE -- 1단계: 검색어에 매칭되는 부서 찾기 matched_depts AS ( SELECT dept_cd, upper_dept_cd FROM tb_dept WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND UPPER(dept_nm) LIKE UPPER(CONCAT('%', #{searchVO.searchKeyword}, '%')) ), -- 2단계: 매칭된 부서의 상위 경로 추적 parent_path AS ( SELECT dept_cd, upper_dept_cd FROM matched_depts
UNION
SELECT d.dept_cd, d.upper_dept_cd FROM tb_dept d INNER JOIN parent_path pp ON d.dept_cd = pp.upper_dept_cd WHERE d.use_yn = 'Y' ), -- 3단계: 전체 트리 구조 생성 (필터링된 부서만) dept_tree AS ( SELECT dept_cd, dept_nm, upper_dept_cd, dept_level, dept_order, dept_mngr_id, use_yn, regist_dt, CAST(dept_cd AS VARCHAR) AS path, 0 AS tree_level FROM tb_dept WHERE (upper_dept_cd IS NULL OR upper_dept_cd = '') AND use_yn = 'Y' AND dept_cd IN (SELECT dept_cd FROM parent_path)
UNION ALL
SELECT d.dept_cd, d.dept_nm, d.upper_dept_cd, d.dept_level, d.dept_order, d.dept_mngr_id, d.use_yn, d.regist_dt, dt.path || '>' || d.dept_cd AS path, dt.tree_level + 1 AS tree_level FROM tb_dept d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.upper_dept_cd = dt.dept_cd WHERE d.use_yn = 'Y' AND d.dept_cd IN (SELECT dept_cd FROM parent_path) ) SELECT dept_cd, dept_nm, upper_dept_cd, dept_level, dept_order, dept_mngr_id, use_yn, TO_CHAR(regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regist_dt, tree_level, path, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_dept WHERE upper_dept_cd = dept_tree.dept_cd AND use_yn = 'Y') AS has_children FROM dept_tree ORDER BY path, dept_order
choose.otherwise:
WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT dept_cd, dept_nm, upper_dept_cd, dept_level, dept_order, dept_mngr_id, use_yn, regist_dt, CAST(dept_cd AS VARCHAR) AS path, 0 AS tree_level FROM tb_dept WHERE (upper_dept_cd IS NULL OR upper_dept_cd = '') AND use_yn = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT d.dept_cd, d.dept_nm, d.upper_dept_cd, d.dept_level, d.dept_order, d.dept_mngr_id, d.use_yn, d.regist_dt, dt.path || '>' || d.dept_cd AS path, dt.tree_level + 1 AS tree_level FROM tb_dept d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.upper_dept_cd = dt.dept_cd WHERE d.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT dept_cd, dept_nm, upper_dept_cd, dept_level, dept_order, dept_mngr_id, use_yn, TO_CHAR(regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regist_dt, tree_level, path, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_dept WHERE upper_dept_cd = dept_tree.dept_cd AND use_yn = 'Y') AS has_children FROM dept_tree ORDER BY path, dept_order

mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_cd , d.dept_nm , d.upper_dept_cd , ud.dept_nm AS upper_dept_nm , d.dept_level , d.dept_order , d.dept_mngr_id , d.use_yn , d.register_id , TO_CHAR(d.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regist_dt , d.updusr_id , TO_CHAR(d.updt_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updt_dt FROM tb_dept d LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_dept ud ON d.upper_dept_cd = ud.dept_cd WHERE d.dept_cd = #{deptCd}
